name: LS-reach-gate-dropped
note: A body across the room joins the pile, and its tab earns 'You are too far away'.

name: LS-members-out-of-order
note: The pile's front is no longer the nearest body.

name: LS-no-body-list-clears
note: The pile-of-drops pick a host casts in the same frame forgets the pile.

name: LS-stale-note-kept
note: Looking away keeps the last pile, and a lone body's window shows the tabs of a pile it is not in.

name: LS-pick-changed
old:
_seen = stack.length < 2 ? null : stack.map((h) => h.key);
  return first;
new:
_seen = stack.length < 2 ? null : stack.map((h) => h.key);
  return stack.length > 1 ? stack[1] : first;
note: The ray answers a body behind the front one - every race the pile is in changes.

name: LS-pile-front-check-dropped
note: A press on a body that is not the pile's front reads the front's pile.

name: LS-pile-by-reference
note: A caller's edit to the pile writes the note.

name: LS-open-body-dropped
note: The body the window is open on loses its own tab once it reads empty.

name: LS-single-body-row
note: A body alone draws a tab row of one.

name: LS-pile-not-carried
note: A tab re-reads the pile off the note, so the row moves under the player's hand (or vanishes once they look away).

name: LS-tab-onto-open-body
old: { if (k !== key && bodies.some((b) => b.key === k)) open(k, all); }
note: The open body's own tab closes and re-opens it.

name: LS-mark-on-a-lone-body
note: Every body's plaque reads as a pile.

name: LS-reset-dropped
note: A pile noted in one world is handed to the next world's press.

name: LS-disabled-body-tabbed
note: A disabled body gets a tab.

name: LS-puppet-body-tabbed
note: A peer's body - its owner's to empty, no window here - gets a tab that closes the window and opens nothing.

name: LS-empty-body-tabbed
old: return count > 0 ? { name: enemyDisplayName(entry.mobileType) ?? 'Body', count } : null;
note: An empty body gets a tab whose press only says 'The body has no treasure.'

name: LS-plaque-mark-gone
note: The plaque stops saying a pile is there.

name: LS-teardown-keeps-note
note: destroyWorldPlaque, every host's door out, keeps the note.

name: LS-pick-bypasses-note
old: return noteBodyStack(nearestActivatableHit(eye, dir, targets, collider), targets, (rest) => nearestActivatableHit(eye, dir, rest, collider));
note: No pick notes the pile, and every window opens without tabs.

name: LS-pile-on-every-frame
note: The wagon and a reward tray draw the pile's tabs.

name: LS-lit-tab-lost
note: No tab is lit, and the open body's own tab re-opens it.

name: LS-tab-row-dropped
note: The enhanced loot window draws no tabs.

name: LS-open-before-close
note: The next body's window opens under the old one, and the old one's close then frees the slot the new one holds.

name: LS-classic-no-wrap
old: const next = pile.bodies[(at + by + n) % n];
new: const next = pile.bodies[Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, at + by))];
note: The picture's click stops at either end of the pile.

name: LS-classic-right-forward
note: RIGHT steps forward like LEFT.

name: LS-classic-open-before-close
note: The next body's window opens under the old one.

name: LS-classic-turn-over-wagon
note: The wagon's picture opens the next body.

name: LS-classic-label-off-by-one
note: The first body reads '0 of 3'.

name: LS-world-quick-take-on-tab
note: A tab with quick loot armed takes instead of opening the body's window.

name: LS-world-pile-dropped
old: const w = makeInventoryWindow({ loot: pile ? { ...loot, pile } : loot });
note: The street and the town draw no tabs.

name: LS-world-one-pool
note: A watchman's body in a mixed pile is asked of the encounter pool.

name: LS-exterior-pile-dropped
old: const w = makeInventoryWindow({ loot: pile ? { ...loot, pile } : loot });
note: The fixed city draws no tabs.

name: LS-exterior-quick-take-on-tab
note: A tab with quick loot armed takes instead of opening.

name: LS-interior-pile-dropped
note: A building's bodies draw no tabs.

name: LS-dungeon-pile-dropped
note: A dungeon's bodies draw no tabs.

name: LS-dungeon-done-window-blocks
note: A dungeon tab closes its window and the next body never opens - the closed window still holds the slot until the frame's drain.

name: LS-dungeon-quick-take-on-tab
note: A dungeon tab with quick loot armed takes instead of opening.

name: LS-encounter-pool-no-word
note: The encounter pool's bodies are never tabs.

name: LS-watch-pool-no-word
note: The watch's bodies are never tabs.
